name: Kula
notes: Site says: "Over 100 integrations to power your hiring workflows" Pricing page shows a flat annual price of $4,800/year. Public Job Boards API uses bearer keys, managed under Settings, API Management; key creation steps are not on the pages read. No partner program found.

review.note: Homepage, pricing, integrations and developer pages read with HTTP 200; no headquarters or partner program stated.
